# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

The environmental information you enter will go into the first two sentences.
The sentence with the exceedance information will be added in.
Example:

On January 8, 2016, Hazardous Waste was being unloaded at the industrial facility.  A strong and unpleasant smell was present.  This prompted staff to begin remediation of a nearby pond that day.  On February 9, 2016, an air sample was taken and deemed to be out of compliance.
